posts.title: Chapter17: Human OCR > Computer OCR
posts.description: We continue to have problems in combat because of OCR. On the discovery of the static RAM layout, we're going to go all-in on RSD. I've made Moose an offer so that we can identify the combat area of RAM: Moose, I have excellent OCR skills as a human and can help. I will take notes with each combat so that I can tell you the count and (active) values for monsters at each round of combat. Deal? ;-)
